enabled.name: Automate explosions
enabled.hint: Explosive weapons (damage with "ex", fragments, stun or smoke grenades) let the thrower pick a token or a spot, scatter on a miss, and give the GM one card with every target's damage. Also enables the GM's /explode command.

wallsCover.name: Explosions: walls are cover
wallsCover.hint: Walls that block movement between the blast and a token add their cover DR against the blast and the fragments (B407-408). An airburst ignores them (B415).

wallDR.name: Explosions: cover DR per wall
wallDR.hint: Cover DR of a wall without its own value (B558: a modern house is DR 6). Give a wall its own with flags.gurps.agency.coverDR. Also the cover DR for someone who dives into cover a step away.

scatter.name: Explosions: scatter on a miss
scatter.hint: A missed explosive attack lands yards away equal to the margin of failure (at most half the distance), in a direction rolled on 1d (B414). Off: the thrower clicks where it lands.

sharedRoll.name: Explosions: one damage roll for NPCs
sharedRoll.hint: B414 rolls blast damage for each target, but lets the GM use one roll for several NPCs. On: NPCs share one roll; player characters still roll their own.

knockbackMove.name: Explosions: move tokens for knockback
knockbackMove.hint: When the GM applies an explosion, push tokens away from the blast by their knockback (B378), stopping at walls.

attack.title: Throw {weapon}
attack.question: Where does it go? Throwing it at {name} lets them dodge; aiming at the ground is +4 with no defense, but everyone there can dive for cover (B414).
attack.manyTargets: Several tokens are targeted: click the spot to aim at.
attack.pickHint: {weapon}: click where to aim (Shift: off the grid; right-click or Esc: cancel).

card.speaker: Explosion
card.scattered: Missed: landed {yards} yd off (direction {direction} on 1d, B414)
card.dodged: Dodged: landed {yards} yd off (direction {direction} on 1d, B414)
card.contact: {name} is on top of it (contact explosion, B415)
card.smoke: Smoke cloud {radius} yd{seconds}: -10 to see through (HT171)
card.gas: Tear gas cloud {radius} yd: two HT-2 rolls, coughing and blindness, while in it and minutes after (HT171)
card.airburst: Airburst: no posture modifier, walls don't protect (B415)
card.extraHits: Rapid fire: {n} more hit(s); set each off with /explode ... target or a clicked spot
card.incendiary: Explosions are incendiary and can start fires (B414, B433)

row.blastInternal: Blast {damage} {type} to the vitals, DR ignored, ×3 (internal)

fire.all: all clothing catches fire: 1d-1 burn/s, -3 DX (B434)

row.knockback: Knockback {yards} yd: DX{mod} or fall down (B378)
row.stunned: Stun: HT {target}, rolled {roll}: stunned; {recovery} each turn to recover (HT193)
row.hotFragments: Hot fragments: 1d(0.2) burn every 10 s for a minute; a DX roll brushes one off (B415, HT172)

dive.success: Dove for cover, made it by {margin}
dive.smother: Threw self on it! (made it by {margin})
dive.tooLate: Too late: the GM has resolved it

command.disabled: Explosion automation is off (Agency fork settings).
command.oneTarget: Target exactly one token for target, contact or internal.
command.pickHint: {label}: click where it goes off (Shift: off the grid; right-click or Esc: cancel).

error.empty: What explodes? For example: /explode 4d cr ex [2d]
error.notExplosive: Not an explosion: {detail} (damage needs "ex", fragments in brackets, or a special munition)

warn.noGM: No GM is online: the explosion was resolved on this client.
warn.otherScene: The explosion is on scene {scene}: view it to measure walls and grid distance exactly.
